statement: The full E3[4] field and projective E4[3] field are exactly M'=Q(i,r), r^4=3/4. Projective E3[12] recovers full E3[4] by the unique global sign fixing its rational point of order3. For Q=SL2(Z/12)/global +/-1 of order576 and N=ker(C2*C3 -> Q) of rank97, explicit finite automorphisms of B/[N,N]N^6 realize twelve pairs in the extra CM coset. After a specified integral cusp gauge they are twelve distinct nonarithmetical finite GT0 shadows. D.27 subsequently proves these twelve selected shadows nongenuine; an alternate homology action with the same CM pair survives both characteristic class-two tests.
where_proved: sections/D_cm_shadow.tex, D.25; code/d_cm_shadow.py, d_cm_shadow.json and d_cm_shadow.out
depends_on: Bass-Serre graph calculation proved in D.25
manuscript_passages: Part D-after-LM2(1); LM2 C.d4-C.d5 simultaneous two-CM-factor image; Part D(e) finite versus genuine profinite lifting
notes: Every claimed finite automorphism has exact rank97 checks modulo2 and3, group hexagon checks and saved CRT cycle coefficients. The graph has480 vertices and576 edges. Candidate counts:48 matrix pairs,24 compatible and24 extra; mod2 cusp admits12+12; mod3 admits24+24; combined finite automorphisms12+12. The quotient order is576*6^97 and the shadow multiplier modulus is36. Centralizer reductions modulo2 for s and modulo3 for r certify that the finite action determines the CM coordinates. No full profinite realization is inferred. D.27 changes no original certificate and proves their genuine nonliftability using both primes and all same-action conjugator freedoms.
